title: Tilly Finds Her Hello

intro.text: Hi friends! I'm Tilly the turtle! I have a story about finding my courage. Are you ready?
intro.speaker: character

outro.text: Remember, a brave hello can make a brand new friend. Bye bye, friends!
outro.speaker: character

moral: Saying hello is how you make a friend.
moralRhyme: Say hi, say hi, don't be shy!
A friendly hello makes two friends grow!

youtube.title: Tilly Finds Her Hello 🐢 A Shy Turtle Story About Making Friends
youtube.description:
Shy Tilly the turtle wants to play, but saying hello is scary. Will she find the courage to make a friend? A warm story about shyness and friendship, with questions for your little one to answer.
#kidsstories #makingfriends #shy #toddlers #moralstories

lines.text: Tilly the turtle loved to watch the other animals play.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: They jumped and swam and laughed all day long.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Crawl, crawl, hooray! I want to play too!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Along waddled Daisy the duck, with a happy quack.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Quack a-lacka-doodle! Hello, little turtle! Come and play!
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: But Tilly hid her head inside her shell.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Oh dear. I am too shy to say hello.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: What should Tilly say to make a friend?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes! Saying hello is how you make a friend!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Tilly stayed quiet, and Daisy swam away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bye bye, Daisy.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Being alone felt big and lonely.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I wish I had said hello.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Suddenly, Tilly had a big, bright idea!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Saying hello is easy and brave!

lines.text: Crawl, crawl, hooray!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Tilly crawled over to the pond, brave and steady.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Crawl, crawl, hooray! I will say hello today!

lines.text: There was Fiona the fox, resting by the water.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Who is this coming this way?

lines.text: Tilly took a deep, brave breath.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hello, Tilly! Want to play?
